visualCharacteristics.purpose: expandable model headers (model name and model year) revealing the press kits for that model

contentPattern.structure: one row per model: model name | model year (optional) | press kits (rich text, usually a cards-press-kit list or links)

usage.note: expandable model-year headers revealing press kits

reuseGuidance: Use for press-kit and tech-spec listings grouped by model. For flat lists without expand/collapse use cards-press-kit directly.
